init_transformerxl_connector: initialize a TransformerXL connector with a pre-trained model name or directory path
get_id_tokenize_string: tokenize a string and convert tokens to their corresponding vocabulary IDs
get_batch_generation_log_probs: get batch generation log probabilities for a list of sentences with masked tokens
get_contextual_embeddings: extract contextual embeddings from the TransformerXL model for a batch of sentences
review_transformerxl_class: review the TransformerXL class methods for tokenization, generation, and embedding extraction
